title: Microsoft Purview DLP: stop Copilot grounding on external emails
summary: The briefing's control, licensing statements, default state and rollout dates are supported by Microsoft documentation and the supplied notice. Two minor checklist-to-table gaps remain: reviewing accepted domains and assigning administrator roles are not represented in the controls table.

claims.claim: The external-email DLP control applies to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat, including email summarisation and reasoning.
claims.quote: It applies to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat, including email summarization and reasoning experiences that use email data.

claims.claim: The control is admin-opt-in: off by default, with no change to existing behaviour unless an administrator enables it.
claims.quote: Off by default.- There is no change unless an admin enables this control in Microsoft Purview.

claims.claim: The control is configured in a DLP policy for the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location.
claims.quote: To set this up, create DLP policies that use the **Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork** policy location

claims.quote: Copilot excludes that email from grounding, summarization, and citation.

claims.claim: PowerShell or API syntax configuring the complete external-email condition and Copilot action is not documented in the references checked.

Read the feature article and New-DlpComplianceRule reference, including FromScope and RestrictAccess; no complete Copilot external-email call is documented. Set-DlpComplianceRule results supply none.

claims.claim: Learn documents no separate tenant-wide toggle for the external-email control.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot external email toggle DLP. Opened the full feature article: setup uses a condition inside a DLP policy. Search results document that same policy mechanism, not a separate external-email tenant toggle.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents New-DlpCompliancePolicy as the policy-creation cmdlet.
claims.quote: Use the New-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) policies in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

claims.claim: The checklist tells administrators to review accepted domains, but the controls table has no accepted-domains row.
claims.quote: Review your tenant's accepted domains, because the rule compares each sender's domain with them. / The table's only row is Whether Copilot excludes external senders' emails from grounding.
claims.fix: Remove the checklist bullet 'Review your tenant's accepted domains, because the rule compares each sender's domain with them.' It names a separate control without a table row; retain the documented comparison mechanism in What's changing.

claims.claim: The checklist tells administrators to assign a policy-author role, but the controls table has no role-assignment row.
claims.quote: Assign the policy author one of the roles listed under Scope, preferably the narrowest. / The table's only row is Whether Copilot excludes external senders' emails from grounding.
claims.fix: Remove the checklist bullet 'Assign the policy author one of the roles listed under Scope, preferably the narrowest.' It names role assignment without a table row; retain the verified role prerequisites in Scope.
